_comment: PDK version pin for the sky130-opamp op-amp-level PVT characterization
harness (issue #17). Same shape and same pin as the sibling
sim/gm-id-characterization/pdk.json this experiment reuses the MOS
process-corner resolution from (../gm-id-characterization/pdk.json and
../gm-id-characterization/corners/model-files.json are read directly by
bin/pvt_sweep.py, not re-resolved or copied here, per this issue's
acceptance criteria: 'using the literal model files already resolved in
sim/gm-id-characterization/corners/model-files.json -- not re-resolved
or guessed independently').
family            sky130 PDK family (via volare)
variant           sky130 flavor directory to use (A/B differ in metal stack)
open_pdks_commit  the volare version hash every record in this experiment
is pinned against -- verified installed and matching
in this environment at ~/.volare/sky130A (2026-09-15)
install_command   reproduces this exact install
default_pdk_root  fallback PDK_ROOT if neither $PDK_ROOT nor `volare path` resolve
ngspice_corner_dir directory holding the per-process-corner .spice include
files this harness points ngspice at directly, same as
../gm-id-characterization's own harness (see that
experiment's corners/README.md for why: the combined
library pulls in RF/ESD/bipolar/high-voltage model
families this op-amp never touches)
rc_corner         this experiment's own addition: sky130's resistor/
capacitor process corner (Rz/Cc's own process spread)
is an axis ORTHOGONAL to the 5-corner MOS grid, exactly
as temperature is orthogonal to it in the sibling
experiment. Every MOS corner in this experiment's own
5x3 grid is run at the SAME (typical) R+C corner --
a stated methodology choice, not a re-derivation of
Rz/Cc's own process spread (out of scope; DR-002
Consequences already flags 'Rz does not track gm2
over PVT' as an open question for a future
compensation-specific bench).

rc_corner.note: Both files are required together: the base file defines tol_m3/rm3/rcvia3-class parameters sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po_1p41's model needs, the __lin file separately defines camimc/cpmimc/*_var_mult parameters sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1's model and the resistor's own process-variation terms need -- confirmed by directly running ngspice against design/netlist/opamp_core.spice with each file included alone (both fail with 'Undefined parameter' errors on Rz/Cc's own model expressions) and together (converges).
